<!-- 背景音乐：自动播放（网易云外链 mp3） -->
<audio id="bgMusic" loop preload="auto" autoplay
  src="https://music.163.com/song/media/outer/url?id=2703890987.mp3"></audio>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   NANA 707 · 純黑白作品集 — 交互脚本
   ========================================================= */
(function(){
  'use strict';

  const $ = (s, c) => (c||document).querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, c) => Array.from((c||document).querySelectorAll(s));

  /* ---------- 载入封面 ---------- */
  const loader = $('#loader');
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(() => loader.classList.add('done'), 1400);
  });
  // 兜底：万一 load 没触发
  setTimeout(() => loader.classList.add('done'), 2600);

  /* ---------- 音频上下文（音效开关） ---------- */
  let audioCtx = null;
  let soundOn = true;
  function ensureAudio(){
    if(!audioCtx){
      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if(AC) audioCtx = new AC();
    }
    if(audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
  }
  // 短促的「嚓」音效，模拟漫画翻页/击掌
  function blip(freq = 1200, dur = 0.05, type = 'square'){
    if(!soundOn) return;
    try{
      ensureAudio();
      if(!audioCtx) return;
      const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const g = audioCtx.createGain();
      o.type = type; o.frequency.value = freq;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, audioCtx.currentTime);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function thump(){
    if(!soundOn) return;
    try{
      ensureAudio();
      if(!audioCtx) return;
      const o = audioCtx.createOscillator();
      const g = audioCtx.createGain();
      o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = 90;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.18);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
      o.start(); o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.18);
    }catch(e){}
  }

  /* ---------- 背景音乐：自动播放 + 右上角播放/暂停 ---------- */
  const bgMusic = $('#bgMusic');
  const soundToggle = $('#soundToggle');

  function playMusic(){
    if(!bgMusic) return;
    bgMusic.play().then(() => {
      soundToggle.classList.remove('muted');
    }).catch(() => {
      // 浏览器拦截自动播放：显示暂停态，等用户点击
      soundToggle.classList.add('muted');
    });
  }
  function pauseMusic(){
    if(bgMusic){ bgMusic.pause(); }
    soundToggle.classList.add('muted');
  }

  if(bgMusic && soundToggle){
    // 音量适中
    bgMusic.volume = 0.5;

    // 打开界面即尝试自动播放
    playMusic();

    // 右上角按钮：切换播放/暂停
    soundToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(bgMusic.paused){
        playMusic();
        blip(900, 0.06);
      } else {
        pauseMusic();
      }
    });

    // 首次用户交互（滚动/点击）时若未播放，尝试补播（绕过自动播放限制）
    const tryAutoplay = () => {
      if(bgMusic.paused && !soundToggle.classList.contains('muted')){
        playMusic();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', tryAutoplay, { once: true });
    window.addEventListener('scroll', tryAutoplay, { once: true });
    window.addEventListener('keydown', tryAutoplay, { once: true });
  }

  /* ---------- 导航 & 面板切换 ---------- */
  const panels = $$('.panel');
  const targets = {};

  function navigate(id){
    // 切面板
    panels.forEach(p => {
      const on = p.id === id;
      p.classList.toggle('active', on);
      if(on){
        // 重新触发进入动画
        p.style.animation = 'none';
        void p.offsetWidth;
        p.style.animation = '';
      }
    });
    // 高亮导航
    $$('.nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.target === id));
    $$('.book-spine').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.target === id));
    // 关闭抽屉
    closeDrawer();
    // 滚动到顶部
    window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
    // 音效
    blip(1000, 0.05);
    thump();
    // 更新标题
    const p = $('#'+id);
    document.title = 'NANA 707 · ' + (p ? p.dataset.title : '作品集');
  }

  // 顶部导航
  $$('.nav-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(btn.dataset.target));
  });

  // 书脊抽屉按钮
  $$('.book-spine').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(btn.dataset.target));
  });

  /* ---------- 每页右滑翻页按钮（动态注入到主页面，首页除外） ---------- */
  const mainOrder = ['home','profile','lines','rules','review','star','credit','price'];
  mainOrder.forEach((pid, idx) => {
    if(pid === 'home') return; // 首页不显示「下一页」按钮
    const panel = $('#'+pid);
    if(!panel) return;
    const nextId = mainOrder[(idx+1)%mainOrder.length];
    const nav = document.createElement('div');
    nav.className = 'panel-nav';
    const label = nextId === 'home'
      ? '回到首頁 · BACK TO TOP'
      : '下一頁 · NEXT';
    nav.innerHTML = '<span class="pn-label">' + label + '</span>' +
      '<button class="next-btn" data-next="' + nextId + '">' +
      '<span class="next-text">' + (nextId === 'home' ? '回首頁' : '下一頁') + '</span>' +
      '<span class="next-arrow">→</span></button>';
    panel.appendChild(nav);
  });
  $$('.next-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(btn.dataset.next));
  });

  /* ---------- 综合板评评分卡 → 板评图集（点击文字区） ---------- */
  const reviewScore = $('#reviewScore');
  if(reviewScore){
    reviewScore.addEventListener('click', () => navigate('review-gallery'));
  }

  /* ---------- 板评左下角图片：可上传 ---------- */
  const reviewPhotoUpload = $('#reviewPhotoUpload');
  if(reviewPhotoUpload){
    reviewPhotoUpload.addEventListener('click', e => {
      e.stopPropagation(); // 阻止冒泡，避免触发评分卡跳转
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'file';
      input.accept = 'image/*';
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = input.files && input.files[0];
        if(!file) return;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = ev => {
          // 替换图片
          const img = reviewPhotoUpload.querySelector('img');
          if(img){ img.src = ev.target.result; }
          blip(1300, 0.06, 'triangle');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      });
      input.click();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 冠名「了解更多」→ 冠名图集 ---------- */
  const creditMore = $('#creditMore');
  if(creditMore){
    creditMore.addEventListener('click', () => navigate('credit-gallery-page'));
  }

  /* ---------- 话术「查看更多」→ 话术图集 ---------- */
  const linesMore = $('#linesMore');
  if(linesMore){
    linesMore.addEventListener('click', () => navigate('lines-gallery'));
  }

  /* ---------- 话术上传图片占位 → 触发文件选择（可替换为跳转） ---------- */
  const lineUpload = $('#lineUpload');
  if(lineUpload){
    lineUpload.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // 创建隐藏的 file input，让用户选择图片（纯前端本地预览）
      const input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'file';
      input.accept = 'image/*';
      input.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const file = input.files && input.files[0];
        if(!file) return;
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = e => {
          // 把选中图片填进占位卡
          const inner = lineUpload.querySelector('.line-upload-inner');
          inner.innerHTML = '';
          const img = document.createElement('img');
          img.className = 'lu-img';
          img.src = e.target.result;
          img.alt = '上傳圖片';
          inner.appendChild(img);
          blip(1300, 0.06, 'triangle');
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
      });
      input.click();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 子页面返回按钮 ---------- */
  $$('.gallery-back').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(btn.dataset.back));
  });

  /* ---------- 书脊抽屉开合 ---------- */
  const drawer = $('#spineDrawer');
  const menuToggle = $('#menuToggle');
  const backdrop = $('#spineBackdrop');

  function openDrawer(){
    drawer.classList.add('open');
    menuToggle.classList.add('open');
    drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    blip(600, 0.04);
  }
  function closeDrawer(){
    drawer.classList.remove('open');
    menuToggle.classList.remove('open');
    drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  }
  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(drawer.classList.contains('open')) closeDrawer();
    else openDrawer();
  });
  backdrop.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if(e.key === 'Escape') closeDrawer();
  });

  /* ---------- 入场按钮 ---------- */
  $('#enterBtn').addEventListener('click', () => navigate('profile'));

  /* ---------- 顶部栏隐藏（下滑隐藏） ---------- */
  const topbar = $('#topbar');
  let lastY = 0;
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const y = window.scrollY;
    if(y > lastY && y > 200) topbar.classList.add('hidden');
    else topbar.classList.remove('hidden');
    lastY = y;

    // 进度条
    const doc = document.documentElement;
    const scrolled = doc.scrollTop / (doc.scrollHeight - doc.clientHeight);
    $('#progressBar').style.width = (scrolled*100) + '%';
  }, {passive:true});

  /* ---------- 粒子烟尘 ---------- */
  const canvas = $('#dust');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let dustParticles = [];
  function resize(){
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  const DUST_N = 60;
  for(let i=0;i<DUST_N;i++){
    dustParticles.push({
      x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
      y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
      r: Math.random()*1.6 + 0.4,
      vx: (Math.random()-0.5)*0.25,
      vy: -(Math.random()*0.35 + 0.05),
      a: Math.random()*0.4 + 0.1
    });
  }
  function drawDust(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    dustParticles.forEach(p => {
      p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy;
      if(p.y < -10){ p.y = canvas.height + 10; p.x = Math.random()*canvas.width; }
      if(p.x < -10) p.x = canvas.width + 10;
      if(p.x > canvas.width+10) p.x = -10;
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.a;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    requestAnimationFrame(drawDust);
  }
  drawDust();

  /* ---------- 拟声词 / 剪报 hover 音效 ---------- */
  $$('.sfx').forEach(s => {
    s.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => blip(1400, 0.07, 'sawtooth'));
  });
  $$('.clip').forEach(c => {
    c.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => blip(800, 0.04));
  });
  $$('.book-spine').forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => blip(700, 0.03, 'triangle'));
  });

  /* ---------- 话术卡片微交互 ---------- */
  $$('.line-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => blip(1100, 0.05));
  });

  /* ---------- 头牌卡牌：翻转 + 弹层阅读 ---------- */
  const cards = $$('.card');
  const cardModal = $('#cardModal');
  const cardModalTitle = $('#cardModalTitle');
  const cardModalContent = $('#cardModalContent');
  const cardModalBackdrop = $('#cardModalBackdrop');
  const cardModalClose = $('#cardModalClose');

  // 随机初始倾斜
  cards.forEach(c => {
    c.style.setProperty('--tilt', (Math.random()*8 - 4).toFixed(1) + 'deg');
  });

  function openCard(card){
    const back = card.querySelector('.card-back');
    cardModalTitle.textContent = card.dataset.title || '頭牌';
    // 克隆背面内容到弹层（大图阅读）
    cardModalContent.innerHTML = '';
    const clone = back.cloneNode(true);
    // 把 photo-slot 提升为大图区
    const slot = clone.querySelector('.card-photo-slot');
    if(slot){
      slot.classList.add('cm-photo');
      slot.classList.remove('card-photo-slot');
    }
    cardModalContent.appendChild(clone);
    cardModal.classList.add('open');
    cardModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    blip(1300, 0.06, 'triangle');
  }
  function closeCard(){
    cardModal.classList.remove('open');
    cardModal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  }

  cards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // 翻转展示背面，再弹层放大阅读
      card.classList.add('flipped');
      setTimeout(() => openCard(card), 260);
    });
  });
  cardModalClose.addEventListener('click', closeCard);
  cardModalBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeCard);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if(e.key === 'Escape') closeCard();
  });

  /* ---------- 键盘导航 ---------- */
  const order = ['home','profile','lines','lines-gallery','rules','review','review-gallery','star','credit','credit-gallery-page','price'];
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    const active = $('.panel.active');
    if(!active) return;
    // 子页面按左/上键返回父页面
    if(active.id === 'lines-gallery' && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')){
      navigate('lines'); return;
    }
    if(active.id === 'review-gallery' && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')){
      navigate('review'); return;
    }
    if(active.id === 'credit-gallery-page' && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp')){
      navigate('credit'); return;
    }
    const idx = order.indexOf(active.id);
    if(e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown'){
      const next = order[(idx+1)%order.length];
      navigate(next);
    } else if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp'){
      const prev = order[(idx-1+order.length)%order.length];
      navigate(prev);
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 图集图片点击放大（可选轻交互） ---------- */
  $$('.gallery-tile .gt-photo img').forEach(img => {
    img.addEventListener('click', () => blip(1200, 0.05));
  });

  /* ---------- 全站随机音乐符号散布（吉他/音符/乐谱等） ---------- */
  const musicIcons = ['i-note','i-notes','i-clef','i-staff','i-guitar','i-pick','i-wave','i-mic'];
  const sprinkleN = 26; // 散布数量
  function sprinkleMusic(){
    const body = document.body;
    for(let i = 0; i < sprinkleN; i++){
      const icon = musicIcons[Math.floor(Math.random()*musicIcons.length)];
      const s = document.createElement('span');
      s.className = 'music-sprinkle';
      // 随机尺寸
      const size = 14 + Math.random()*40;
      // 随机位置（避免顶部导航和右侧抽屉）
      const x = Math.random()*(window.innerWidth - size - 20) + 10;
      const y = 70 + Math.random()*(window.innerHeight - size - 70);
      s.style.left = x + 'px';
      s.style.top = y + 'px';
      s.style.width = size + 'px';
      s.style.height = size + 'px';
      // 随机透明度与动画延迟
      s.style.setProperty('--mo', (0.10 + Math.random()*0.18).toFixed(2));
      s.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*3).toFixed(1) + 's, ' + (Math.random()*4).toFixed(1) + 's';
      // 随机旋转
      s.style.transform = 'rotate(' + (Math.random()*360).toFixed(0) + 'deg)';
      s.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 64 64"><use href="#' + icon + '"/></svg>';
      body.appendChild(s);
    }
  }
  sprinkleMusic();

})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
